source_organisation: Ministerio de Educación, Formación Profesional y Deportes

dataset_title: Encuesta sobre Equipamiento y Uso de TIC en los Hogares 2025
population_universe: Main family dwellings in Spain and residents; one person aged 16+ selected per dwelling, with information on children aged 10-15
methodology: Three-stage stratified sample survey; collection 31 Mar-13 Jul 2025 via telephone and web
limitations: Not a survey of parents. Age-band GenAI results are proxies for plausible parent-age cohorts; subgroup N is not reported in the press-release evidence used.

dataset_title: Encuesta sobre el uso de TIC y del comercio electrónico en las empresas 2024-2025
population_universe: Spanish enterprises stratified by size, activity and autonomous community
sample_size: 25,000 companies: 15,074 with 10+ employees and 9,926 with fewer than 10
limitations: Headline AI/cloud metrics for 10+ employee firms are contextual and not a direct match for Chleo's approximately 5-10 employee business.

dataset_title: Use of artificial intelligence in enterprises
